comments.text: The opening is what got me — Lee Kuan Yew crying on live TV because independence was an expulsion, not a victory, and then the answer being that for 200 years Singapore sold the world exactly one thing: a place to stop. That framing made the whole thing click.

comments.author: @TheEarthEngineOfficial
comments.text: The 'country made of borrowed things' framing is striking — imported sand, imported water, imported talent, yet the world's busiest transshipment port. Do you think the water deal expiring in 2061 is Singapore's real deadline, or will NEWater and desalination have fully closed that gap by then?
